title: Wooden Chest

sources.title: Wooden Chest
markers: '''Wooden Chest''' is a type of [[Container]] that can be picked up or thrown by the player. They usually contain [[Consumables]], [[Equipment]], [[Miscellaneous]] items and other randomized common loot.

fields.Durability: 50 HP. Sturdy requires at least 10 damage per hit. Resists Piercing, Necrotic and Radiant, is vulnerable to Bludgeoning and immune to Poison and Psychic.
fields.Variants: Buried examples require a shovel and weigh about 44 lb. Other wooden chests can weigh about 22 lb.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
